param_input_item.param_description: 3-by-3 finite nonsingular projective transformation matrix. When omitted, the identity transform is returned.

param_output_item.param_description: Structure with Type, Dimensionality and T fields that can be passed to imwarp.

description.p: Create a 2-D projective transformation structure containing a nonsingular 3-by-3 matrix T. The structure can be passed to imwarp.

example_item.example_item_description: Warp an image with a projective transform
